1946, March 12.
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Cascy, O.F.M. Cap.
MY GREAT GOAL - THE SUPREME PURPOSE OF MY CREATION AND EXISTENCE.
TO KNOW MY GOD.
God made me to know Him. 0! What a bless'd aim!
To love Him and serve Him sure rests in the same. It's Heaven begun for the grateful on eearth. -- To treasure arigh ! ? ! Highest Heaven its worth.
God Himself is the reward even here below
( though only as a shadow, comparatively).
But dear Doctor Koch: what I wanted to propose for you is something like this. You have shown quite a little interest in the one great science necessary for real contentment in this world and for supernatural hope in the life awaiting us beyond the
Unfinished Draft/
